label: Stepper
description: A numbered progress rail with Back/Next and a Finish on the last step. It publishes Current Step and a Completed signal and deliberately does not hold your content: you mount each step's Group against Current Step, so a step is an ordinary part of your page rather than something trapped inside a container. Steps behind the current one collapse to a tick. Out of the box it renders four sample steps; connect your own array (Title per item) to Steps and it wins over the samples. Pairs with Form Fields, one fieldset per step.
